Scrap is an asset used to Level your Factories, Mines, and Facilities at a rate of 1:1:1 meaning; 1 Scrappable Asset : 1 Scrap : 1xp.

So you would need 100k of a Scrappable Asset to Level a Facility 1 time or 5M of a Scrappable Asset to Fully Level a building.

The only purposes for Scrap are leveling your buildings, and Developing Reincorporation Computer for which you will need 100k.


Clothing factory is best for scrap because of its fast production of assets
